## Description

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the monorepo code conventions and formatting.
- [ ] I have tested these changes locally (`npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` pass).
- [ ] For desktop changes, I verified the overlay renders and operates properly without UI anomalies.
- [ ] For backend/gateway changes, existing test suites pass (`npm run test`).
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation / cheatsheet JSON files where necessary.
- [ ] There are no leaked secrets, private API tokens, or hardcoded personal credentials in this PR.
